subject: Question on how to use mplusRcov

messages.author: 4440e8c8c5e7d338
messages.subject: Question on how to use mplusRcov
parts:
Hi, 

I am wondering if there is a way to use mplusModeler and mplusRcov together. 
I would like to run the following code but with changing variance and covariance settings. I've read mplusRcov document, but it is still not clear to me how I can run a model with different settings using mplusRcov. Any examples/tutorials out there?

In case it makes things more clear, here is my example code for mplusModeler. 

lca_k1_6  <- lapply(1:8, function(k) {
  lca_enum  <- mplusObject(
     
    TITLE = glue("Class {k}"),
   VARIABLE = glue(
   "
     classes = c({k});
     usevariables = var1-var10;
     categorical = var1-var10;
     missing = ALL (999);
     "),
  
   
    ANALYSIS =
     "estimator = mlr;
      type = mixture;
      processors = 8;",
   
    OUTPUT = "sampstat residual tech4 tech10 tech11 tech12 tech14;",
   
    PLOT =
      "type = plot2 plot3;",
   
    SAVEDATA = glue("FILE = save_c{k}_lca_trace_week12_model6.txt; SAVE = cprob;"),

    rdata = df12)
 
 
 
lca_enum_fit <- mplusModeler(lca_enum,
                            dataout=glue("c_lca_trace_week12.dat"),
                            modelout=glue("c{k}_lca_trace_week12_model6.inp"),
                            check=TRUE, run = TRUE, hashfilename = FALSE)
})

Best,
Heeryung
